metadata.title: DugganUSA Threat Intelligence for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: One deployment: the DugganUSA TAXII 2.1 connector plus hunting queries. Needs a Sentinel-enabled workspace and a DugganUSA API key (free at https://analytics.dugganusa.com/stix/register).
Your Microsoft Sentinel (Log Analytics) workspace name, in this resource group
OnceADay fits the free tier (10 queries a day). Choose OnceAnHour with a paid key.
Import indicators added after this time (default: the last 7 days). Older indicators are mostly stale.

properties.query:
// DugganUSA: what arrived. Run this after connecting to see the feed is live in your workspace.
// Counts DugganUSA indicators by type, with their newest arrival and highest confidence (never above 95).
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Data.created_by_ref) == "identity--f4a8c3d2-1b9e-4f7a-8c2d-9e3f5b6a7c8d" or SourceSystem has "DugganUSA"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| summarize Indicators = count(), NewestArrival = max(TimeGenerated), MaxConfidence = max(Confidence)
    by IndicatorType = tostring(split(ObservableKey, ":")[0])
| order by Indicators desc

properties.displayName: DugganUSA - New C2 in the last 6 hours
properties.query:
// DugganUSA New C2: connections to command-and-control IPs that arrived in the last 6 hours.
// Reads ThreatIntelIndicators (see dugganusa-ioc-match.kql). Verified 2026-10-19 against a synthetic log row.
let dugganusa_identity = "identity--f4a8c3d2-1b9e-4f7a-8c2d-9e3f5b6a7c8d";
let NewC2 =
    ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where tostring(Data.created_by_ref) == dugganusa_identity or SourceSystem has "DugganUSA"
    | where ObservableKey == "ipv4-addr:value"
    | extend Types = tostring(Data.indicator_types), Labels = tostring(Data.labels)
    | where Types has_any ("botnet_cc", "c2", "command-and-control") or Labels has_any ("botnet_cc", "c2", "command-and-control")
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
    | project C2 = tostring(ObservableValue), Confidence, IndicatorName = tostring(Data.name), IndicatorStixId = tostring(Data.id);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| join kind=inner NewC2 on $left.DestinationIP == $right.C2
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, DeviceAction, Confidence, IndicatorName, IndicatorStixId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
